scope: Narrow correction of the P17-M0 R3 CR-02 documentation claim; sealed M0 evidence, report and source-custody findings are not modified.

r3Addendum.claimLocator: Code review finding table, CR-02 row

observations.r3Claim: R3 described the content audit, claim qualification, final manifest and closure nested records as strictly contracted and marked CR-02 closed for M0 by layered validation.
verifiedFacts: The content-audit and claim-qualification schemas constrain many nested records with required keys and additionalProperties=false.
The report-final-manifest schema leaves seven important nested records or item records at type-only validation.
The validation-closure schema leaves six important nested records or item records at type-only validation.
The dependency-free validator implements a documented subset and does not fail on unsupported schema keywords.
generatorProtections: The M0 finalizer constructs the R3 artifacts deterministically.
The M0 finalizer checks selected evidence-chain hashes and immutable report bytes.
The R3 artifacts carry canonical self-hashes and an implementation inventory.
residualLimitations: A generic independent validator cannot derive complete nested semantics from the two shallow schemas.
Generator-time assertions do not make every stored nested record schema-strict.
Unsupported JSON Schema keywords can be silently ignored by json-schema-lite.

correction.correctedStatement: M0 R3 is protected by deterministic construction, canonical hashes and targeted generator assertions, while complete nested schema validation for the final manifest and validation closure remains open debt for P17-M1.
unchangedClaims: P17-M0 report visual and semantic reproduction QA

requiredClosureEvidence: Every M1 authoritative nested record is constrained by a supported schema validator or explicit semantic validator.
Unknown or unsupported schema keywords fail closed.
Stored-artifact validation is independently runnable without regenerating the artifact.
Nested required-key deletion, extra-key, enum, hash, NaN/Infinity, duplicate-ID, cross-field-binding and unknown-keyword mutations are rejected.

hashPolicy.rule: correctionHash = lowercase hex SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(document without top-level correctionHash after recursively sorting every object key; array order is preserved and no insignificant whitespace is emitted).
